    SELECT {for <ele>, <alias> in <group_by>, <alias_list: LIST[ALIAS]> ADD ',': <ele> AS <alias>}, <bit_and_value> AS <alias_value: ALIAS>, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY <group_by> ORDER BY <bit_and_value>) AS <alias3: ALIAS>
    FROM <tables>

    FROM <alias1>
    WHERE <alias3> = 1

    SELECT {for <alias> in <alias_list> ADD ',': g.<alias>}, CASE WHEN g.<alias_value> IS NOT NULL THEN BITAND(r.<alias4>, g.<alias_value>) ELSE r.<alias4> END, g.<alias3>

FROM <alias2> r
